madeFor: The caravan's cart, a member of the party that is hit and goes down and never acts (decision 0059). It stands on the party's side and faces east. It has no clip for a travel: the scene is to move the still picture. Its down ends in its wreck, which is to stay on the road; the wreck's lowest row is 4 px below the standing cart's, and it is drawn by the standing picture's foot as every prop's down is, so it lies that much lower, which the owner saw and kept. Issue-353 adds the cart to the engine, draws it and names it in `props`.

parameters.description: small two-wheeled wooden handcart piled high with bulging tan grain sacks, no cover, flat side-on profile, one large spoked wheel in the middle, the cart points to the right, its two pull shafts stick out on the right side of the picture, no animal, black outline, warm earthy tones, NES-era retro pixel art, few colors

hit.animationDescription: the cart jolts from a heavy blow: it rocks back on its wheel and settles again, the sacks shaking, no particles, no effects

down.animationDescription: the cart breaks apart: its wheel snaps off and falls flat, the cart drops and tips onto the ground, the pull shafts snap and the sacks tumble out around it, no particles, no effects

endFrame.editDescription: the cart is wrecked and abandoned: its wheel has broken off and lies flat on the ground beside it, the cart's body has dropped onto the ground and tilts down at one end, one pull shaft is snapped, and the tan sacks have spilled onto the ground around it; same side view, same colors and black outline, nothing above the cart
